desc: Ideation complete: Defined DP state, transitions, and reconstruction strategy using forward and backward DP.
Implement forward DP: `dp[i][c][r]` storing min cost for prefix [0:i] ending with char c and run length r (capped at 3).
Implement backward DP for suffix costs: `min_suff[i][c][r]` storing min cost to complete suffix from i given prev char c and run r.
Reconstruct the string by iterating positions and choosing the smallest character c that satisfies: `dp[i][c][new_r] + min_suff[i][c][new_r] == min_total` (with appropriate boundary checks).
Handle edge cases: impossible to form good caption, n<3.
